# QR Code Generator 2.0.4

Unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from the MIT-licensed npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`.
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

The small adjacent declaration describes only the API used by this project. QR encoding runs locally; addresses are never sent to an external QR service.
